_readme: Q89 inc.14 — the scorer bundle for the SECOND published Gulf Coast meeting, the one that
actually decides whether C-2018's Action Items block renders ranked.
WHY THIS ROW AND NOT ANOTHER COMPANY. inc.13 ranked A-MTG-2026-06-16-GULFCOAST-AIALEX (4 of 4)
and the company page stayed in source order — correctly, because `meetingIntel` calls a block
ranked only when EVERY item carries a rank, and C-2018 merges TWO meetings: 4 ranked + 8
unranked = 12 items, 4 ranked. Ranking these 8 is the whole remaining distance between a
correct degrade and a ranked block on screen.
PROVENANCE. Every `source_line` and every non-null `evidence` value below is a literal span of
`MLE Internal Meetings/archive-reads/2026-07-22-gulfcoast.deepread.txt` — 117,619 bytes, the
uncapped `find_meeting.py --page … --deep` read of Notion page 3a51de57-0199-802b-b9f8-
f59fa153a013 (784 blocks / 114,354 chars) logged in `docs/research/Q84-READ-LOG-2026-08-05.md`
§1. THAT FILE WAS ONLY EVER IN /tmp UNTIL THIS INCREMENT. It has now been archived beside the
other deep reads, because a transcript the gate checks against cannot live somewhere the OS
may delete: an unverifiable bundle and a verified one would have become indistinguishable the
first time the machine rebooted.
NOTHING NEW WAS MINED. The eight items are the eight `action-items` entries already live on
C-2018 from `2026-07-22-gulfcoast.activity.json` (inc.7), re-expressed in the scorer's schema.
No new fact, no inferred status, no re-read.
OWNERSHIP AND STATUS ARE STILL UNRESOLVED. The Notion body lists ten to_dos and never names an
owner or a completion for one. All eight ship `owner: UNRESOLVED` and no `due_by` — the record
states no date for any of them, and a date read off 'soon' is an invented one.
MOST RUNGS HERE ARE INFERRED, ON PURPOSE AND VISIBLY. A to_do list is a thinner record than a
transcript passage: it says WHAT was committed and almost never says who is blocked, how long
it takes, or what is lost by being late. Where the line itself establishes a rung it is quoted
(`evidence`); where it does not, `evidence` is null and `rationale` carries the reasoning, and
the scorer renders that rung as INFERRED so the doubt reaches Rob instead of being laundered
into a number. Filling `evidence` with reasoning to make the output look better-sourced is the
exact defect the scorer's gate A exists to catch — and it refuses the file when tried.
